newsitem.title: FRANCE: Axor to open Warrington warehouse.
newsitem.headline: Axor to open Warrington warehouse.

text.p: Axor, the European subsidiary of French road and air express distribution company, Jet Services, aims to generate traffic in north-west England as well as London and the West Midlands when it launches its Coventry-Paris/Charles de Gaulle freighter service later this month, a company official told Reuters on Wednesday.
Air Jet, Jet Services' airline subsidiary, is scheduled to launch the nightly all-cargo rotation on October 21 using a 4.5-tonne capacity Metroliner aircraft.
The Coventry-CDG route is part of a strategy to extend the distribution network of Axor's "next-day" European express service, the official said.

"Having recently announced plans to rent a 1,500 square metres building at Coventry airport and similar-sized facilties, near Hemel Hempstead, to handle shipments, we have since decided to occupy a 400 square metre warehouse at Warrington thus enlarging the catchment area of the freighter service."

The freighter service will offer UK firms located in the London/Birmingham business corridor and in the Manchester/Liverpool area, next-day delivery deadlines between 8am and 9am to France, Benelux and Germany, the official added.
